meta.title: Past date
meta.description: A day two days behind the clock: everything has happened, and there is no now indicator.

scenario: The schedule is showing a day two days before the current one. Every item has already happened, so the question the component has to answer is what a schedule means when none of it is ahead of you.
look: No now indicator. It is drawn only in the shift that holds the current moment, and that shift is two days away.
Nothing is dimmed for being over. Only the resolved level is drawn muted, and that is true on any day.
The headings are still previous, current and next: they are relative to the date being shown, not to today.
Navigation and pinning behave exactly as they do on the current day.
uses: <link to="/shifts-and-dates/">Shifts and dates</link> — the selected date, and the shifts drawn around it.
